records.title: ESS administrative umbrella
records.summary: ESS is the administrative umbrella; Chief of ESS is administrative, not substantive superior.

records.title: Internal Audit and J2 boundary
records.summary: Internal Audit and J2 remain outside ESS substantive authority; Audit remains functionally independent.

records.title: Continuity is capital
records.summary: P&C prioritizes long-duration capability, internal mobility, development, and dignity over routine churn or up-or-out.

records.title: Candidate dignity covenant
records.summary: After substantive human interview contact, rejected candidates receive human, specific, respectful closure.

records.title: Exploration assessment menu
records.summary: Eight standardized assessments: Unknown, Build, Teach, Hand-off, Judgment Under Trade-offs, Critique, Prioritization, Self-correction.

records.title: Work/Next Chapter review
records.summary: Performance and development split into candid work discussion and Next Chapter conversation; no ratings theater or up-or-out.

records.title: Workforce reduction doctrine
records.summary: No layoffs merely to polish profitability; reversible levers, redeployment, leadership sacrifice, candor, and dignity precede unavoidable RIFs.

records.title: Technology Services as internal product engineering
records.summary: IT restores capability, builds paved roads, and operates internal technology as products; business product engineering stays with businesses.

records.title: Strong security, low theater
records.summary: Security by architecture, yes-securely posture, system monitoring not employee surveillance, distinct identities and bounded agent delegation.

records.title: Vertical authority horizontal expertise
records.summary: Functions own profession; businesses own work; dotted lines do not decide.

records.title: Portfolio architecture
records.summary: Business autonomy requires coherent economics/mission and capable leadership; default hierarchy stays flat.

records.title: Finance truth boundary
records.summary: Finance is imperial over financial truth but bounded on business judgment.

records.title: Continuous capital allocation
records.summary: Standing business envelopes, quarterly outlooks, annual cross-portfolio allocation, ad hoc extraordinary opportunities, no use-it-or-lose-it.

records.title: Planning and performance rhythm
records.summary: Continuous visibility, exception-triggered dialogue, quarterly conversations, annual deep strategy/capital; forecasts are estimates not promises.

records.title: Three-ring executive architecture
records.summary: Small authority core, broad 25-40 person information ring, temporary issue rooms; J2 supports information fidelity without decision ownership.

records.title: Decision and meeting doctrine
records.summary: One accountable owner; proportional records; challenge before decision; meetings must justify cost and participants.

records.title: Sacramento headquarters visual direction
records.summary: Canonical Sacramento campus is beautiful, formidable, low-rise modern institutional architecture; September 3 exterior render controls visual language.

records.title: Develop SHMS
records.summary: Next workstream must mine existing decisions before drafting SHMS; SHMS is doctrine/cases/tiny stewardship, not an IT system or bureaucracy.
